quests.sentenceWithBlank: I saw ___ owl sitting on the fence this morning.
quests.completedSentence: I saw an owl sitting on the fence this morning.
quests.grammarRule: Indefinite article before a vowel sound
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Owl' begins with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'. This is also the first time the owl is mentioned.
quests.nativeTip: 'Owl' opens with a vowel sound.
quests.visualAnchor: 🅰️ an: Indefinite article before a vowel sound
quests.example: I saw an owl sitting on the fence this morning.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: I saw an owl sitting on the fence this morning. ___ owl didn't move at all.
quests.completedSentence: I saw an owl sitting on the fence this morning. the owl didn't move at all.
quests.ruleExplanation: Once the owl has been introduced, the next mention takes 'the' — 'the owl' means that specific one, not just any owl.
quests.nativeTip: You're referring back to that same owl now.
quests.visualAnchor: 🎯 the: Second mention / anaphoric reference
quests.example: I saw an owl sitting on the fence this morning. the owl didn't move at all.

quests.sentenceWithBlank: My neighbor adopted ___ elderly cat from the shelter, and now the cat follows her everywhere.
quests.completedSentence: My neighbor adopted an elderly cat from the shelter, and now the cat follows her everywhere.
quests.grammarRule: Indefinite article before a vowel sound
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Elderly' begins with a vowel sound, so 'an' is correct — 'an elderly cat'. Notice how the sentence later switches naturally to 'the cat' once the cat has already been introduced.
quests.nativeTip: Focus on the sound of the word right after the gap.
quests.visualAnchor: 🅰️ an: Indefinite article before a vowel sound
quests.example: My neighbor adopted an elderly cat from the shelter, and now the cat follows her everywhere.
